Read the 40-second intro

Hi, I'm Vamsi Krishna Lekkala. I teach machines to match messy data, then I go home and build AI products. At Staples, I lead an AI-assisted entity-resolution platform built with Snowflake, Snowpark, Claude through Snowflake Cortex, Python, and FastAPI. It moved match accuracy from about 65 percent to about 90, and cut 10,000-record jobs from nearly 50 minutes to about 15. Outside work, I ship products including Lucy, VibeFlow, Trace, Distill Books, DeskMate, and AI Maastaaru. My rule is simple: a metric matters when it changes what users can actually do.
